b.x: Almost everything on this page was measured in rats. It is not a prescription, not a fast, not a substance. Medicine, if any, belongs to the doctor. If the wish is to die, in Brazil dial 188. This page does not dial.
What increases it, in the rat

The firmest factor is voluntary movement. Running, in the rat, increases birth in the hippocampus more than almost anything else tested. An environment with novelty also increases it: space, a new object, what asks for exploration. Learning a task that demands memory increases it. Sleep takes part. Without it, the day's gain does not firm up. Some antidepressants, in animal studies, increase birth in that region. That explains a research hypothesis. It is not a license to take a pill on your own. Isolating the factor is what the laboratory does. In life, they arrive together: whoever moves sleeps better, sees something new, and rehearses the same fear less.
What decreases it, in the rat

Stress that lasts for weeks decreases it. High cortisol, all the time, is one of the most studied brakes. It is not the fright of one minute. It is the alarm that does not switch off. Broken sleep and short sleep decrease it. Too much alcohol decreases it. Continuous inflammation decreases it. Age decreases the rate, in the animal, clearly. A very fatty diet and isolation also show up as a brake in several studies. None of this is a sentence on a man. It is a direction. The gray man recognizes the brake he himself feeds: rehearsing catastrophe all day is chronic stress. The workshop, if it exists, does not bloom inside the repeated film.

You do not count the neurons. You move the factors that, in the animal, open the workshop, and that, in the human, already change attention, mood, and memory. Move the body almost every day, at the pace it can hold. Sleep for real, on the night of the training. Learn one small thing. See people, even if it is one sentence. Eat food, not only product. Drink less, if alcohol is already daily. Take the film out of command: one minute on the foot, the name of the feeling, and return. That does not prove a neuron was born. It proves you stopped feeding the brake and started feeding use. If the sadness is already an illness, the chemical factor is a doctor's conversation, not a forum's.

It refuses powder, drops, fasting as a technique, and any sale of a hippocampus. It refuses turning cortisol into guilt. A fright on the street does not erase the workshop. The brake is the alarm that lasts for weeks. It refuses waiting for the right marker before you act. The law of the day is still the connection that is used. If the human workshop is open, these factors are the ground. If it is almost closed, the same factors still change what you can do tomorrow. A new neuron without a gesture saves no one. A repeated gesture, with sleep, may meet a neuron. And it saves even without one.
